once_only.description: Grow the root partition only on the first boot. After a successful run a sentinel file is written; all subsequent boots skip the script. Set to false to attempt resize on every boot (not recommended for production images).

sentinel_file.description: Absolute path of the one-time sentinel file written after a successful grow. Only relevant when once_only is true. The file is created inside the real root filesystem, not the initramfs.

partition_settle_wait_sec.description: Seconds to sleep after growpart exits, giving the kernel time to re-read the updated partition table before the root filesystem is mounted read-write. Increase on slow virtual storage backends.

growpart_binary.description: Absolute path to the growpart executable (shipped by cloud-guest-utils on Debian/Ubuntu or cloud-utils on RHEL). Change only when growpart is installed in a non-standard location inside the initramfs.

skip_partitions.description: Partition numbers (as strings) that must never be auto-resized. Use this to protect EFI system partitions, BIOS-boot partitions, or reserved swap slots.

partition_number.description: Partition number to exclude from automatic grow, e.g. "2" or "15".

reboot_after_grow.description: Trigger an immediate kernel reboot via /proc/sysrq-trigger after resizing. Required on some cloud images where the in-memory partition table cannot be updated live. This bypasses normal init-bottom processing — use only when necessary.
